name: baize
description: Baize (白泽) coding agent: HTTP server, ACP agent, stdio CLI and desktop runtime
author: harry

scripts.coverage:tools: c8 --all --include "src/tools/{FileReadTool,FileWriteTool,FileEditTool,GlobTool,GrepTool,LSPTool,BashTool,PowerShellTool,TaskOutputTool,TaskStopTool,WebSearchTool,WebFetchTool,TodoWriteTool,AskUserQuestionTool,ToolSearchTool,EnterPlanModeTool,ExitPlanModeTool}/**/*.ts" --include "src/tools/ScheduleCronTool/Cron*Tool.ts" --include "src/tools/shell-runner.ts" --include "src/tools/AgentTool/AgentTool.ts" --include "src/tools/SkillTool/SkillTool.ts" --include "src/services/tools/**/*.ts" --exclude "**/prompt.ts" --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=lcov --reporter=json-summary --check-coverage --lines 80 --branches 65 --functions 75 --statements 80 vitest run --project scripts src/tests/suites/tools.test.ts && tsx src/tests/check-coding-tool-coverage.ts
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:worker && npm run build:agent && npm run stage:agent-runtime && npm run build:agent:native
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:desktop && npm run desktop:start
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:ripgrep && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:ripgrep -- --target win32-x64 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64
scripts.desktop:pack:mac:x64: npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:ripgrep -- --target darwin-x64 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64
scripts.desktop:pack:mac:arm64: npm run build:desktop && npm run stage:ripgrep -- --target darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p src/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w protocol -w sdks/typescript
scripts.lint: eslint src protocol/src sdks/typescript/src sdks/typescript/examples web/src desktop scripts start.js "vitest*.config.ts" eslint.config.js
